subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens

Hi Alex 

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can put together a tight pricing proposal:

Recap of what you said on the call:
- Primary product use: conversational assistant + summarization for customer-facing workflows.
- Current steady-state: ~80M tokens / month (mostly chat).
- Growth profile: expecting 3-5x in 6-12 months depending on feature rollout (planning for 300-400M tokens / mo).
- Peak event: occasional spikes up to ~1B tokens in a high-traffic month.

Two asks so we can benchmark unit economics and send a target price:
1) Can you confirm your target $/1M tokens (the price we should model to hit your monthly budget range)? If you don't have a target, a helpful frame is: target price band (e.g. $100-200 / 1M tokens) or max acceptable.
2) Please confirm monthly budget range for inference (or a top-of-wallet number we should aim under).

For transparency, we typically benchmark target $/1M around these ranges depending on model family and committed volume: OpenAI ~ $180-250 / 1M tokens, Anthropic ~ $160-230, competitive open-model hosts range widely $90-180 (volume & quantization dependent). We'll provide a tailored comparison once we lock your steady-state and peak volumes.

Attached: acme_token_estimates.xlsx -- if you can confirm or update the volumes in that sheet it will speed the proposal.

Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up this week to confirm volume buckets and agree on a pricing band we should model. What time works for you?

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>

Cc: Finance Ops <finance@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens

Hi Rachel 

Thanks for the follow-up and the clear recap. Quick answers:
- Confirming current steady-state is roughly 80M tokens / mo.
- We expect to reach ~400M tokens / mo in ~6 months as we roll out the assistant to more teams.
- Peak: yes we can see spikes up to ~1B tokens in promotional months.
- Budget: we are targeting a ballpark inference budget of $30k-60k / mo initially, with an option to expand if unit economics look good.

Target pricing: our procurement target is in the range $120-200 per 1M tokens. Ideally we'd like to see a proposal that hits <= $150 / 1M at our 6-month volumes (400M / mo) with committed terms.

I've attached a short internal estimate (same numbers, with expected month-by-month ramp) -- hope that helps.

If you can model Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic at the $/1M level for our two volume buckets (80M and 400M) that would be ideal. Available for a follow-up Tue/Thu next week (mornings PT).

Best,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product -- ACME Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M tokens

Alex -- thanks, this is perfect and very helpful.

We're going to model two scenarios for you:
- Scenario A (no commit): per-token hosted pricing at your 80M and 400M volumes using Redwood standard hosted tiers vs OpenAI/Anthropic public rates.
- Scenario B (committed capacity / annual commit): aggressive unit economics with committed discounts targeted to reach <= $150 / 1M at 400M tokens.

Preliminary benchmarking (high-level, will include in the deck):
- Redwood (hosted, initial quote estimates): $140-160 / 1M tokens at 400M with a 12mo commit; $200+ at 80M without commit.
- OpenAI (public-ish comp): ~$180-220 / 1M tokens for similar chat workloads (varies by API / context length).
- Anthropic: ~$170-210 / 1M tokens.
- Open-model hosts (self-hosted or other managed hosts): wide range $90-170 depending on quantization, model choice, and commit.

I'll attach a short comparison PDF and a simple cost model showing target $/1M to get you into the $30k-60k / mo budget band.

Next steps:
- Vanessa / Marissa -- can you help confirm the conservative committed discount band we can promise for ACME (12mo)? I think we can target $140 / 1M at 400M with a modest commit, but please confirm so I can put a formal number in the deck.
- Alex -- are you ok with Tue/Thu mornings PT next week? I can propose Thu 10:00 AM PT if that works.

Thanks -- sending the comparison now.

Rachel
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
